fields.name: Batch
fields.definition: An ordered list of batch steps that ArgentSea executes on one connection inside one client-managed ADO.NET transaction, committed only when every step succeeds. There are three kinds. A database batch runs on a non-sharded connection; a shard batch runs on one shard. Both may return a result: a value, a list of values, a model, or one or more shard keys. A shard-set batch runs the same steps on every targeted shard, each shard in its own transaction, and returns no result. The batch is the only place ArgentSea enlists a client-side transaction. Its main purpose is to combine non-query work, such as a bulk load, with queries in one transaction.
